# 🚀 Nuvio Enhanced iOS v0.4.14

- Apple see-through Liquid Glass floating tab bar with spring morphing & gesture bridging
- Auto-hide tab bar on scroll down & reveal on scroll up
- Hero stretch overscroll with elastic rubber-band pull-down physics
- Smooth scrolling optimizations across all tabs
- Rapid profile switcher popover with PIN verification
- Indefinite background downloads via audio keep-alive & Files app support
